title: Next Permutation
statement:
Given an array of N distinct integers representing a permutation, rearrange it into the lexicographically next greater permutation of its elements.

If no next permutation exists (the array is in descending order), rearrange it to the smallest possible permutation (ascending order).

Algorithm:
1. Find the largest index i such that A[i] < A[i+1]. If none, reverse the whole array.
2. Find the largest index j such that A[j] > A[i].
3. Swap A[i] and A[j].
4. Reverse the suffix starting at A[i+1].
inputFormat:
Line 1: a single integer N.
Line 2: N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: N space-separated integers on a single line: the next permutation.
constraints:
1 <= N <= 10^5
1 <= A[i] <= 10^9
All elements are distinct.

examples.explanation: No next permutation; wrap around to [1,2,3].
